progress_log.summary: Found NexusOne drop root cause (bot echoed server-pushed GeyserHash item back via MobEquipment after inventory sync) and gated the echo behind new GeyserNoHeldItemEcho profile flag; also verified gophertunnel already sends SetLocalPlayerAsInitialised.
progress_log.validation_result: go build ./... OK; go test ./... all packages pass; live NexusOne run 60s: 3172 S2C, last S2C at 59.9s, 0 watchdog warnings (previously died at ~8.4s); control HansProjects run 95s: 10776 S2C, last S2C at 94.9s, 'Login successful.', 0 watchdog warnings.

progress_log.summary: goal_control:complete — NexusOne silent-disconnect fix (GeyserNoHeldItemEcho gate) verified live: 60s capture run with continuous S2C (previously died ~8.4s), 95s control run on HansProjects clean, full Go suite green. User's later sessions on Geyser servers remained stable.

evidence.description: Live verification of the NexusOne disconnect fix (GeyserNoHeldItemEcho gate): BOT_PACKET_CAPTURE run against play.nexusone.fun:19132 for 60s — 3172 S2C packets, last S2C at ms=59923, zero C2S MobEquipment echo (previously the only extra packet vs the surviving HansProjects run), zero 'connection lost after a long silence' warnings. Before the fix the server went permanently silent at ~8.4s.

progress_log.summary: Built subsystem map of internal/bot/* and gathered primary sources on mineflayer-movement heuristics and mindcraft-ce feature delta.
progress_log.validation_result: Confirmed via list_directory: internal/bot has 23 subpackages incl. movement (gaze.go, steering.go, follow.go, physics.go, path.go), exploration/explorer.go, rand/, planner/, perception/, survival/, combat/, jev/. Fetched mineflayer-movement README (4-heuristic steering model with fov/rotations/blend params) and mindcraft-ce README (explicitly labels original mindcraft pathfinding as "standard robotic movement").

progress_log.summary: Mapped the autonomy stack: agi.Runner.Tick, jev question set, survival.Manager.Tick, and confirmed idle falls through to Wander.
progress_log.validation_result: Read agi/runner.go and agi/brain.go and survival/{manager,actions}.go. Confirmed: (1) agi.Runner.doActivity maps ActivityApproach -> r.Wander() (stub, does not approach) and ActivityRest -> a log line only; (2) the no-urgency path in Tick() calls maybeWander() every tick, so idle == wander; (3) Wander() launches Explorer.ExploreRandom on context.Background() uncancellable; (4) survival.Manager.Tick() calls only tickAutoEat+tickAutoArmor, so SleepInBed/AutoPlaceTorches/BuildEmergencyShelter/RecoverFromDeath/UseHealingPotion are never invoked proactively; (5) survival/actions.go uses fixed blocking time.Sleep(80-1000ms) with no variance. jev question set is 4 questions with a 5-option activity menu (rest/wander/explore/gather/approach).

progress_log.summary: goal_control:complete — Research complete. All 6 requested areas covered, OSS precedent surveyed with fetched sources, and a prioritized feature list delivered with per-item complexity, subsystem mapping, and risk flags.

evidence.description: Primary-source review of DimsumMentAI autonomy stack confirming the specific behavioural gaps: agi/runner.go:208 (idle falls through to maybeWander), runner.go:218-228 (ActivityRest is a log line, ActivityApproach calls Wander), runner.go:563 (uncancellable context.Background wander goroutine), survival/manager.go:109-112 (Tick drives only auto-eat + auto-armor, so SleepInBed/AutoPlaceTorches/BuildEmergencyShelter/RecoverFromDeath/UseHealingPotion never fire proactively), survival/actions.go:284,298 and combat/shield_bow.go:179 (fixed blocking time.Sleep with zero variance), perception/visible_blocks.go:67-70 (perception scans a full axis-aligned cube with no FOV cone), jev/questions.go:24-30 (5-option activity menu), agi/brain.go:33-45 (Snapshot lacks time-of-day, light level, tool durability, inventory fullness).

External research gathered: mineflayer-movement README (raycast FOV steering with distance/danger/proximity/conformity heuristics, fov=240/rotations=15/blend=1); mindcraft-ce README ("standard robotic movement" criticism, door/gate/swim upgrades); zenn.dev first-hand build log (deterministic Executor beats LLM freedom; reverse tech-tree priority ordering; 1x1 shafts trip invalid_player_movement, use staircase mining; pathfinder.stop() leaves server-side desync; 2/3 reliability at stone tier, 0/3 at iron); Generative Agents (memory retrieval = recency+importance+relevance, reflection threshold 150, ~2-3x/day, full arch most believable); gophertunnel PlayerAuthInput docs (client sends once every tick, server-authoritative movement); Minecraft Wiki (walk 4.317 m/s, sprint 5.612 m/s, jump 1.2522 blocks; creeper 30-tick/1.5s fuse, triggers within 3 blocks, requires uninterrupted LOS, no idle/step sounds); bedrock.dev detection systems; Mineflayer issue #3899 anti-cheat false positives.
